map.供应商综合评分对比 使用指南: Supplier Composite Score Comparison User Guide
map.输入多个供应商的质量/价格/交期数据，自定义权重，系统自动计算综合评分并排名，辅: Enter quality, price and delivery data for several suppliers, set custom weights, and the system computes composite scores and rankings automatically to support purchasing decisions.
map.三家供应商比选：填各自合格率、报价、准时率，设质量/价格/交期权重，自动加权排名: Compare three suppliers: enter each one's qualification rate, quote and on-time rate, set the quality/price/delivery weights, and the tool ranks them automatically and recommends the top one.
map.招标定标：将商务评标中质量分、报价分、交期分代入，按既定权重得出综合分辅助定标。: Tender award: substitute the quality, price and delivery scores from the commercial bid evaluation, apply the established weights to get a composite score and support the award decision.
map.价格权重敏感性分析：调高价格权重看排名是否反转，验证选型对价格的依赖程度。: Price-weight sensitivity analysis: raise the price weight and see whether the ranking flips, to verify how much the selection depends on price.
map.以「A/B/C 三家，权重 质量40/价格30/交期30」为例: Take "three suppliers A/B/C, weights quality 40 / price 30 / delivery 30" as an example
map.：数据：A(合格率98.5,报价100,准时96)、B(95,92,98)、C(: Data: A(qualification rate 98.5, quote 100, on-time 96), B(95, 92, 98), C(99, 110, 92). With normalized weights quality 0.4 / price 0.3 / delivery 0.3 and the lowest price 92 as the full-score baseline: score A = 98.5*0.4 + min(92/100,1)*100*0.3 + 96*0.3 = 39.4 + 27.6 + 28.8 = 95.8; B = 95*0.4 + 100*0.3 + 98*0.3 = 97.4; C = 99*0.4 + (92/110*100)*0.3 + 92*0.3 = about 92.3. Ranking: B(97.4) > A(95.8) > C(92.3), so supplier B is recommended.
map.到货准时率与合格率统计: On-Time Delivery and Qualification Rate Statistics
map.价格维度采用相对最低价映射：以参评供应商中的最低报价为满分基准，其余按 最低价/: The price dimension uses a relative lowest-price mapping: the lowest quote among the evaluated suppliers is the full-score baseline, and the rest are converted as lowest price / own quote x 100. This avoids the unreasonable steep drop where a higher quote yields a lower quality score, while still letting a genuine price advantage take full marks. If a quote is above the lowest, its price score decreases by the ratio.
map.权重怎么设才合理？: How Do I Set Weights So They Make Sense?
map.战略物资、技术复杂件应重质量与交期（如质量 50/价格 20/交期 30）；标准: Strategic materials and technically complex parts should weight quality and delivery (for example quality 50 / price 20 / delivery 30); standardized, fully competitive items can weight price more. Weights are normalized automatically and the three need not sum to 100; the tool scales them by proportion. Set them with your procurement strategy and category risk in mind.
